texts.explanation: flag-becomes-retry: a node that declared onInvalid: flag kept a reply that did not fit its format at 30, and the job ran on; at 31 the node asks once more with the validation error, then fails, so its prompt ends with the retry's text, the job fails, and a text only 30 has is what 30 ran on the kept reply (#1508, comment 5, item 3, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25 (onInvalid: flag becomes retry); comment 6, item 3; part 05 § 1.2; part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)
